mapper.select: select c.COMPANY_ID from scc_sup_company_info c left join meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_sou_vendor ssv on c.COMPANY_ID = ssv.vendor_id left join meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_pj.scc_sou_vendor pjssv on c.COMPANY_ID = pjssv.vendor_id where c.CREATION_DATE < DATE(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 YEAR)) and ssv.project_id is null and pjssv.project_id is null

select c.ORG_CATEGORY_ID from scc_sup_org_category c left join meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_sou_vendor ssv on ssv.vendor_id = c.COMPANY_ID left join meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_sou.scc_sou_item ssi on ssi.org_ou_id = c.ORG_ID and ssi.category_id = c.CATEGORY_ID and ssv.project_id = ssi.project_id left join meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_pj.scc_sou_vendor pjssv on pjssv.vendor_id = c.COMPANY_ID left join meicloud_usrm_cloud_biz_pj.scc_sou_item pjssi on pjssi.org_ou_id = c.ORG_ID and pjssi.category_id = c.CATEGORY_ID and pjssv.project_id = pjssi.project_id where ssv.project_id is null and ssi.project_id is null and pjssv.project_id is null and pjssi.project_id is null and c.CREATION_DATE < DATE(DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 2 YEAR))
